Method of Attack: Local privilege escalation via automatic installation of Razer Synapse software with SYSTEM privileges when plugging in a Razer device
Exploitation of 'Choose a Folder' dialog during installation to open a PowerShell window with SYSTEM privileges
Attack Vector: Physical access by plugging in a Razer mouse or keyboard device
Indicators of Compromise: Automatic download and execution of RazerInstaller.exe with SYSTEM privileges
PowerShell prompt launched with SYSTEM privileges during installation
